t: The Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed Fire Rated LED Recessed Downlights in chrome offer efficient and safe illumination for various indoor settings. These integrated LED downlights are dimmable, providing adjustable lighting to suit any ambiance, making them ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces. Featuring a robust steel body and an IP65 rating, they are suitable for Zone 1 bathroom installation. Fast installation is achieved with a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, and the downlights are easily fitted using a standard 57mm holesaw. With a long life of 50,000 hours and a warm white 3000K colour temperature, these fire rated downlights deliver reliable performance and a welcoming glow.
